title: Aubert duality and co-tempered Langlands data
summary: Let $F$ be a non-archimedean local field of characteristic 0, and let $G$ be either $\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}(F)$ or $\mathrm{SO}_{2n+1}(F)$. We introduce a new algorithm to compute the Aubert dual at the level of Langlands data. This algorithm acts as the dual to the recent Lanard-Mínguez algorithm. It fundamentally differs in two ways: it follows a bottom-up approach rather than a top-down one, and its internal computations strictly preserve the temperedness of the representations. Consequently, this approach naturally yields a new constructive characterization of co-tempered representations. By…
